app.notLoggedIn: Not signed in — scan the QR code to sync playlists

login.title: NetEase QR Code Login
login.smsHint: Enter the phone number registered with NetEase, request a code, then sign in (no password).
login.qrScan: Scan with the NetEase Music app
login.notConfirmed: The QR code is authorized but the login state is not confirmed yet. Refresh the QR code later, or check the API address and proxy settings.
login.subtitle: You will be asked to re-scan when the session expires
login.hint: Credentials are stored only in the local data directory. If verification times out, check the API address and HTTP(S) proxy in Settings.

playlists.needLogin: Please sign in on the Account Login page first.
playlists.countHint: {{count}} playlists; enable a switch to include it in auto sync
playlists.dlWarnQuality: Some songs can only be downloaded at a lower quality than selected: {{detail}}
playlists.pruneConfirmTitle: Clean local files no longer in this playlist?
playlists.pruneConfirmDesc: Files on disk that are no longer in this playlist will be moved to quarantine, never deleted directly.
playlists.backupTitle: Back up to a local directory
playlists.backupLikedHint: Download all liked songs into the chosen directory (not counted as synced for any playlist).
playlists.backupPurchasedHint: Download all purchased songs into the chosen directory (not counted as synced for any playlist).
playlists.qualityLimitHint: This account can download this song up to {{level}}
playlists.qualityLimitHint2: Downloadability and max quality are marked per song based on this account's entitlements.
playlists.dlNamePlaceholder: Filename template, empty for global setting
playlists.dlOverwrite: Overwrite existing file with the same name

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.extra: Files removed from playlists are kept here first; they are never deleted directly
quarantine.confirmDesc: It cannot be restored through this app after deletion.

settings.moved: Data migrated to the new directory
settings.dataApp: Using the system app data directory
settings.dataDesc: Config, credentials, database, logs and cache live in this directory. Copy the whole app folder to move it. All settings changes are saved automatically.
settings.separatorTip: Used to join multiple artists, e.g. Artist A、Artist B
settings.rootExtra: Downloads, playlist folders and the .quarantine directory live here.
settings.downloadSourceExtra: Different API instances may support different URL endpoints; switch manually if needed.
settings.labelRetry: Retries per track on download failure
settings.cbPreflight: Pre-check song availability and max quality before downloading
settings.uaTip: May affect entitlement detection on some endpoints; usually no change needed.
settings.apiExtra: Use a server compatible with NeteaseCloudMusicApi Enhanced. Public instances may return 403 depending on network or access policy.
settings.proxyExtra: Only used to reach the configured API service; empty for direct connection. e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897
settings.filenameTemplateExtra: Variables: {音轨号}, {歌手}, {标题}, {专辑}, {网易云ID}
settings.cbNcm: Convert .ncm files to mp3 / flac automatically
settings.cbNcmKeep: Keep the original .ncm file after conversion (uncheck to delete the source)
